name: overview-native-tracker
goal: Read Project Overview from the native Tracker after cutover while preserving fixed loopback reads and fail-closed validation.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Native hub after cutover returns 200 for /items and /runs, 404 for /machines and 200 for /status with a machines array. Existing Explorer and publisher fail closed before projection.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The tracked readProjectOverview standard transport case exercised only a tracker with /machines. Extend it to also require native /status.machines on a dedicated 404 while preserving strict URL, HTTP and response assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed ff4b15e536. Fixed-GET case rejected the native 404 fixture with unavailable where ready was expected; 1 failed, 12 passed.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Fallback is restricted to a 404 on fixed /machines. Native /status shares the same deadline, and only the validated machines field reaches the overview.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen red failed on ff4b15e536; the same committed test and runtime passed all 13 cases on ebded0133e. Reports focused suites passed all 57.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
